# Vendored Iconoir icons

- File: `iconoir.css` (icons inlined as SVG data URIs, fully offline)
- Version: 7.11.1
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/iconoir@7.11.1/css/iconoir.css
- License: MIT (https://github.com/iconoir-icons/iconoir/blob/main/LICENSE)

Why vendored: the study pages must work on a lab network **without
internet**. Loading icons from a CDN broke every icon offline.

To update: download the new version from the URL pattern above into this
folder and update the version numbers in this file. Nothing else to change —
the pages link to `/static/vendor/iconoir/iconoir.css`.
